limitations: Linux WebKit is not Safari/iOS; emulation is not a physical phone.
Native zoom keyboard attempt had no effect: 1440x900 DPR1 before and after. Native 200% zoom remains unverified; narrow viewport checks are not a substitute.

Initial keyboard-driven phone scene test failed; pointer wheel-based continuation successfully navigated all phone cases. Initial failures retained as runner evidence, not claimed as a touch-navigation site defect.
Rotation kept open menu state; no rotation screenshot retained.
Gallery destination reviewed in source, not clicked in this run; real email delivery and mail-app launch were not tested.

findings.issue: Desktop booking claims receipt although nothing is sent; name alone opens success with no date or contact.
findings.fix: Keep a realistic booking flow, validate date/contact details, and end with an explicit demo-only/no-request-sent confirmation.
findings.evidence: initial/chromium/booking-confirmation.png; booking result; sign.html inline submit handler.

findings.issue: Guest count, date and time have no accessible labels.
findings.fix: Add persistent labels to all booking fields.
findings.evidence: Axe select-name and label findings on sign.html.

findings.issue: Time field ignores ArrowDown; FAQs are divs with tabIndex -1.
findings.fix: Provide a keyboard-operable time selector and FAQ buttons with expanded state.
findings.evidence: Chromium time keyboard remained 7:00 pm; FAQ tab -1.

findings.issue: Booking modal leaves focus on the submit button and has no accessible name, Escape handling or focus containment.
findings.fix: Name dialog; move/trap/restore focus; allow Escape and reachable close.
findings.evidence: booking result activeElement is Request Table; source confirmation markup/handlers.

findings.issue: Booking hints and review labels/initials fail normal-text contrast.
findings.fix: Darken foregrounds/backgrounds while preserving the palette.
findings.evidence: Axe ratios: time hint 2.99, note 2.75, review meta 4.47, initials 3.01; requirement 4.5.

findings.issue: Home navigation is visually hidden but its links remain keyboard-focusable.
findings.fix: Make the hidden navigation inert until shown.
findings.evidence: Remaining Chromium landing first focus is nav-logo while nav opacity 0.

findings.issue: Reduced-motion preference still runs scrolling animation and a 1.5-second mobile screen transition.
findings.fix: Disable nonessential animation and screen glides when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Remaining Chromium: scrollDot; track transition 1.5s; inline transition set by JS.

findings.issue: Pages omit main landmarks or leave content outside them; reservation portrait is described as a book.
findings.fix: Correct landmarks and image alternatives without changing artwork.
findings.evidence: Axe region/main findings on five pages; booking screenshots show portrait where alt says Reservation book.

findings.issue: Reviews explicitly claim Real words from real tables without a demo/sample indication.
findings.fix: Label fictional testimonial content as sample reviews.
